name: FACTS Grounding
intro: FACTS Grounding评估模型能否仅依据给定长文档生成满足请求且完全有据可依的长篇回答。基准包含860条公开Open样本和859条私有Blind样本，文档平均约2.5k tokens、最长32k tokens，并用三种评判模型分别校准资格与事实性。
org: Google DeepMind, Google Research, Google Cloud, Kaggle
build_method: 第三方人工构题, 全量人工核验, 平衡随机划分, 两套金标集校准多评委提示
task_type: 长上下文问答, 摘要, 文档改写, 事实立足性验证
eval_feature: 860条公开集+859条私有盲测, 最长32k上下文, 三评委资格共识, 三评委事实性聚合
scale: Open 860条 + Blind 859条；平均2.5k、最长32k tokens
task_type_en: Long-context QA, Summarization, Document Rewriting, Grounded Factuality Verification
build_method_en: Third-party Human Task Authoring, Full Manual Verification, Balanced Random Splits, Multi-judge Prompt Calibration on Two Golden Sets
eval_feature_en: 860 Open + 859 Blind Examples, Up to 32k Context, Unanimous Three-judge Eligibility, Three-judge Factuality Aggregation
intro_en: FACTS Grounding evaluates whether models can produce long-form responses that fulfill a request using only a supplied long document and remain fully grounded in it. It contains 860 public Open and 859 private Blind examples, with contexts averaging about 2.5k and reaching 32k tokens, and separately calibrates eligibility and factuality prompts for three judge models.
scale_en: 860 Open + 859 Blind examples; mean 2.5k, maximum 32k tokens
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.03200. Third-party raters create context-only Q&A, summarization, and document-rewriting tasks over web documents in five enterprise domains; all examples are manually checked and creative, expert-knowledge, mathematical, meta-analysis, and OCR-unreadable cases are removed. Balanced random sampling yields 860 public Open and 859 private Blind examples, with contexts averaging about 2.5k and reaching 32k tokens. Eligibility prompt selection tests two templates on a separate N=450 golden set, and a response is disqualified only when Gemini 1.5 Pro, GPT-4o, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet all agree. Factuality prompt selection tests seven templates on N=402 and chooses the best Macro-F1 template per judge. A response is accurate only if every informative claim is supported; ineligible responses count as inaccurate, and the final score averages the three judges' accurate-response percentages.
